_note: THE CHAIN (src/game/courses/chain.ts, Phase 21 4.6): the centre's chain modules as a course in the range, SpeedKills only, so the owner can play the distances. Every gap's width is worked out from src/config/reach.json when the course is built, as docs/PHASE_21_LAYOUT.md's modules are: the run gap is a sprint jump's carry over runSpare (20% to spare); the double gap midway between the jump's carry times over and the double jump's times under; the wall gap midway between the double jump's carry times over and the wall run's kick's times under. A retune of the movement moves the gaps with it, and tools/checks/sk-chaincourse.ts proves each again. Each gap room is climbed into: a deck deck metres up (a climb), the pit, a deck, down to the floor for the next door (the course's doors are 3.3 m from the floor). runUp is each deck's length before its pit: a sprint is full in 1.35 s, about 12 m from a climb. Fall below the deck by fallBelow over a pit and the room restarts with 2 s added, as in the other courses. The chimney is city.json's chimneys: the same width, length, rise and landing.
_window: The window pad (the brief's module: a pad that throws you through an open window onto a deck floor). The pad takes you to its middle and throws you straight up (course.ts CoursePad), so every entry speed flies the same arc. The sill is sill metres up, past a double jump and a climb (two 4 m storeys), so only the pad gets you in. Your feet peak apexOver above the sill and the push into the window starts at overAt above it; the push is fast enough to carry the whole body through the wall (standOff from the pad to its face, wall thick) in safety of the time the feet spend over overAt. The opening is width wide (0.59 m clear either side of a 0.81 m body) and height tall: a 1.83 m body at its peak, apexOver, and 0.4 m clear over the head. The brief's 2.2 m window cannot keep 0.4 m clear over a standing body, so the window is sized from the body. deck is the floor behind it, where the finish is. runUp is the floor from the door to the pad, room for a full sprint (1.35 s, about 12 m).
_chimney: THE CHAIN's chimney (courses/chain.ts): two runnable walls `width` apart and `length` long, `wall` thick, closed at the far end, its landings `rise` up a storey each and `landing` deep. The owner's chain as geometry (docs/PHASE_21_LAYOUT.md); it was city.json's chimneys, of which the course used these and not the old city's own canyons.
